lines.zh: 四条短腿驮着厚重的甲
lines.en: Four short legs carry my heavy armor
I shuffle along close to the ground
My tail swings like a stone club
Sunlight glints off my armored back
I climb the mound one step at a time
The gravel flattens beneath me
These bones are heavy, so I cannot hurry
I head for the ferns
The low grass reaches me easily

lines.zh: 我的路是用肚子量出来的
lines.en: I measure my path with my belly
My armor rasps against a trunk

lines.zh: 我慢慢转身，甲片跟着动
lines.en: I turn slowly and my plates shift
My tail groove trails behind like a furrow
One sniff, and this one is edible
White island shore, and the soil is soft
I walk head down to save my strength

lines.zh: 我背上的甲板擦过灌木。
lines.en: The armor plates on my back scrape the shrubs.

lines.zh: 我又长又重，可我很安静
lines.en: Long and heavy, yet I make little noise
I lie still and let the sun warm my shell
Motionless, I look like a boulder
Wind slips between my plates
I chew the fern still in my mouth
Eyes half shut, I listen to the field
My tail rests heavy and steady on the ground
Something approaches, so I hold still
I blink once, very slowly
This shell has no plans to move aside
The wood goes quiet, and so do I
I lift my head, then set it back down
The mud on my plates has dried
No one to chase, grass is enough
I settle into the hollow to rest

lines.zh: 谁也别想从我背上咬进去
lines.en: No one bites through my back
I rest my chin on the grass
You are looking at my flank, why
I will not strike you, but do not push me
I raise my short neck and look
One more step and I brace myself

lines.zh: 我的甲片朝你竖了一下
lines.en: My plates bristle toward you

lines.zh: 我们之间隔着一段安全
lines.en: A safe distance lies between us
I am slow, but I am patient

lines.zh: 人类的个子，比我想的高
lines.en: A human is taller than I expected

lines.zh: 我背上的甲，一节节都硬了。
lines.en: Every plate on my back has stiffened.
Do not stand behind my tail
Head tilted, I am judging you

lines.zh: 这些岛上没见过你这样
lines.en: The island never showed me your kind
Who touched my shell
I let out a muffled grunt
That one landed heavily
I shifted half a step
My neck pulled in briefly
It hurts, but the shell holds
I turn around, slowly
Do not count on me falling
My tail club slams into the mud.
I grunt and keep chewing
I know the smell of that tender leaf
Hand it over and I will stay put
I stretch my neck and still cannot reach
Set it down, I will come over slowly

lines.zh: 这叶子比树皮好吃多了
lines.en: These leaves beat bark by far
I chew slowly, do not rush me
That is exactly what I was after
The scent pulls me two steps forward
When I finish, I will stop following
Something this soft is rare
I lower my head, nose first
Good leaves, I will remember them
Do not pull your hand back, I am not done
I will walk after this smell
That grass for this mouthful, fair trade
Slowly now, one bite at a time
You walked into my armor

lines.zh: 我退了半步，你退得更远
lines.en: I shift half a step, you go further

lines.zh: 硬壳和骨头，声音不一样
lines.en: Shell and bone do not sound the same
I did not move, you did
Head down, I am just another rock
Mind my tail
That bump barely registered
Standing still is an answer too
My shell is not empty air
Go around me, I am not quick

lines.zh: 怀特岛的水边见过同类
lines.en: I have seen my kind by the island shore

lines.zh: 同类相遇，先比谁的甲厚
lines.en: When kin meet, the thicker shell speaks first
I drum the ground with my tail
My low call is not a threat

lines.zh: 找到伴侣，就走同一条路
lines.en: With a mate, we share one trail
There is grass enough for two
We walk side by side, slowly
Among kin there is no race

lines.zh: 这身甲需要一个同样厚的同伴
lines.en: This shell needs a mate just as thick

lines.zh: 一起趴下，晒同一片太阳
lines.en: We lie down and share the same sun
I dip my head and take the leaf

lines.zh: 背甲上落的东西，我甩掉
lines.en: Whatever lands on my shell, I shake off
So small my foot would crush it
I nudge it aside with my mouth
It is stuck between my plates
Picked up means slowly chewed
I balance it on my snout

lines.zh: 地上的东西归我先到者
lines.en: Ground litter goes to whoever comes first
I sweep it into the grass
Another burden on my back
Whoever bumps me first, I watch
I slowly turn toward that direction
I am no longer grazing head down
My tail lifts first

lines.zh: 打算动手的，别装路人了
lines.en: If you mean to fight, stop playing a passerby
My armor is already facing you
I will not chase, but I remember you
That step crossed the line
I am deciding whether to hit back

lines.zh: 低头吃草的我也能战斗
lines.en: Even a grazing tank can fight
I keep my eyes on your feet

lines.zh: 你绕到后面我也不转头
lines.en: Circle behind, I still will not turn my head
The tail is already waiting
We can hold like this all day
You move first, and I meet you
No cover on open grass
My breathing grows heavier

lines.zh: 这一撞你要是接得住，就试试
lines.en: If you can take this charge, try
All four feet are planted
I am guarding my patch of grass
The tail swings like a stone club
I shoulder you out of the way
A head-down charge lands solid
The edge of my plates scrapes you

lines.zh: 站稳了，我还会再来一下
lines.en: Stand firm, there is more coming
I have no fangs, but I have weight
That was a warning
Bone on bone, that stays with you

lines.zh: 我转身的力气全在尾巴上
lines.en: All my turning power is in my tail
You get shoved back several blocks

lines.zh: 我在这片白垩土上醒来
lines.en: I wake on this chalky soil
The island wind wakes me
I eat a clump of ferns first

lines.zh: 我的甲还带着石头的凉
lines.en: My plates still carry the chill of stone

lines.zh: 每一步都像从地下拔出来
lines.en: Each step feels pulled from underground
Cretaceous grass tastes familiar
I settle and grip with all four feet
No kin around, only me
I shake out my armored back
This place is good for grazing

lines.zh: 我低吼了一声，无人回应
lines.en: I grunt once, and nothing answers

lines.zh: 我低下头，世界变得很矮
lines.en: I lower my head and the world gets small
My plates are baking hot

lines.zh: 从坡上滚落，我重重着地
lines.en: I roll off the slope and land hard
Water covers my shell and I panic
The blast jolts my armor loose
An arrow lodges in a seam of my plates

lines.zh: 那股力量穿过了我的硬壳
lines.en: That force reached through my hard shell

lines.zh: 草吃完了，我的肚子空了
lines.en: The grass is gone and my belly is empty

lines.zh: 雷落在甲上，酥麻传遍全身
lines.en: Lightning hits my shell and numbness spreads

lines.zh: 脚下空了，我的甲也没用
lines.en: The ground vanishes and my armor is useless
